name: Park Sun-Hee
bio:
Park Sun-Hee's journey into motorsport PR began unconventionally, after a career in corporate communications for a major electronics firm. During a company sponsorship deal with a local racing team, she discovered a passion for the high-octane world of racing. Recognizing the unique challenges and opportunities in motorsport PR, she transitioned her skills to focus on building and maintaining a positive public image for drivers and teams. 

Sun-Hee is known for her meticulous planning and data-driven approach. She excels at crafting compelling narratives that resonate with diverse audiences, from hardcore fans to casual observers. Her ability to anticipate potential PR crises and develop proactive strategies has earned her a reputation as a highly effective and reliable PR officer. What sets her apart is her blend of Eastern and Western communication styles, making her adept at navigating the global motorsport landscape.

Her meticulousness extends beyond planning, as she is known for her unwavering dedication to clients, ensuring every detail is perfect.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair with subtle highlights and a side parting.
physical.description: Park Sun-Hee is a poised woman of medium build with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with press contacts and potential story angles.
Insists on double-checking all press releases and social media posts, even when under tight deadlines.
Keeps a collection of lucky charms from different racing series on her desk.
